title: Keep chat history instead of deleting it after 30 days
description: Raises the transcript retention default from 30 days to 9999. The value is only a default — an explicit cleanupPeriodDays in settings still wins. The default is rewritten where it is read, not where the constant is declared: on split builds the bundler can declare and export the constant from a different chunk than the one that reads it (2.1.282: read in one chunk, `var Ann = 30` in another), and a declaration search scoped to the reading chunk then finds nothing.

sites.description: settings.cleanupPeriodDays ?? <const>, inside the `* 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000` age computation. Every retention sweep derives its cutoff from this one expression; the other reads of the constant only feed the retention_sweep telemetry event.

verify.describe: retention default at the read site now reads 9999
